subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about funded accounts for {Brand}. With Nigerian fintech unit economics under fresh scrutiny in 2026, the band matters: reported consumer banking CAC sits near $258, and a neobank booking a $50 marketing CAC really spends $85 to $105 per active customer once KYC, deposit bonuses, and drop-off are added. That spread is where funding-event screening and incrementality decide your true cost per funded account. PalmPay clearing 15 million transactions a day shows the supply has to deliver users who reach that funded state. Worth a quick compare?
angle: fresh angle: 2026 Nigerian fintech CAC-burn scrutiny + banking CAC band $258 / loaded $85-$105
register_notes: Stage 2 EN Nigeria neobank native English: acknowledges second follow-up + references prior outreach in first sentence; fresh angle = timely 2026 scrutiny of Nigerian fintech customer-acquisition burn + REAL web-verified banking CAC band (consumer banking CAC ~$258 and loaded $85-$105 per active customer, prospeo 2026 benchmarks, retrieved) and PalmPay 15M daily transactions (techcabal 2025, retrieved); cites one peer move from brand_candidates (PalmPay); MobUpps holdout/incrementality referenced without a figure so zero illustrative flags; exactly one question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'.
